texts.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的居民因我们所共享的科技而感到喜悦。他们纷纷来到我们位于他们星球上建立的飞地，狂轰滥炸般地询问有关我们文化和历史的问题。

[pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对向我们学习的渴求增进了我们提升该文明科技进展的任务进度，因此我们修改了最初关于任务所需时间的估计。
texts.en:
The people of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] are delighted with the technology we have been sharing with them. They have flocked to the enclaves we established on the surface of their world, bombarding our scientists with questions about our culture and history.

The eagerness of the [pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to learn more about us has accelerated our mission to advance the technological progress of their civilization. We have revised our initial time estimates.

texts.zh: 很不幸，我们发现[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[pre_ftl_species.GetName]很难教育。我们的科学顾问报告称，这些外星人对于放弃自己的传统、接纳新的概念和理念这一方面转变得十分缓慢。看来我们的任务时间会比预期要长一些。
texts.en: The [pre_ftl_species.GetName] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have unfortunately proven difficult to teach. Our scientific advisors report that the aliens are slow to abandon their ways and slower still to adopt new concepts and ideas. It would seem that our mission of enlightenment may take longer than expected.

texts.zh:
我们在安排科学家去执行[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的科技发展任务时遇到了困难。因为[pre_ftl_species.GetName]……独特的外貌和气味，这么说吧，能站在他们面前都很不容易。

去[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]地表执行任务被大家视作一种惩罚。这很不幸地拖累了我们的任务进度。
texts.en:
We are having difficulty finding scientific advisors willing to take part in our mission of technological development on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. Given the... unique appearance and odor of the [pre_ftl_species.GetName], being in their presence is a challenge, to say the least.

An assignment to the surface of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has come to be regarded as a punishment. This has unfortunately delayed the progress of our mission.

texts.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]是天生的科学家。驻扎在它们母星上的顾问对它们取得的进步感到惊讶。顾问们在报告中称，我们推动[pre_ftl_species.GetName]文明进入太空时代的任务或许可以提前完成。
texts.en: The [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural] of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have proven to be natural scientists. Our advisors stationed on their homeworld are impressed with the progress they have been making. Their reports indicate that our mission to advance the [pre_ftl_species.GetName] civilization to the Space Age may finish ahead of schedule.

texts.zh: 我们为[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]带去科技发展的任务，其进度相较于日程表提前了，这在很大程度上是由于它们不同寻常的智力。尽管这个文明还很年轻，但我们的科学顾问在[pre_ftl_species.GetName]上面看到了巨大潜力。
texts.en: Our mission to bring technological development to the [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] is proceeding ahead of schedule, in large part due to their unusual intelligence. Although theirs is a relatively young civilization, our scientific advisors see great potential in the [pre_ftl_species.GetName].

texts.zh: 在和我们派往[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的科学家进行长期接触后，当地原住民对于其他物种和文化的接受程度提高了很多。[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]不再那么容易对外来事物表现出排斥的态度了。
texts.en: Prolonged contact with our scientific advisors on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] seems to have made the natives more accepting of other species and cultures. The [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural] are no longer so quick to react with revulsion when they look upon something that is alien to them.

texts.zh: 在和我们派往[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的科学家及顾问紧密合作之后，[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]对所有和外星事物有关的方面都产生了浓厚的兴趣。
texts.en: After working closely with our scientists and advisors on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName], the [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural] seem to have developed a deep interest in all things that are alien to them.

texts.zh:
我们的顾问报告称，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的原住民不仅对我们的科技着迷，它们甚至也在模仿我们的行为举止。

他们似乎大体上接受了我们崇尚和平和非暴力的哲学。自我们到来以来，各种[pre_ftl_species.GetName]文化团体之间的冲突几乎停止了。
texts.en:
The natives on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have not only become enamored with our technology, but our advisors report that they are also beginning to emulate our ways.

They seem to have largely adopted our philosophy of peace and non-violence. Since our arrival, conflict between the various [pre_ftl_species.GetName] culture groups has all but ceased.

texts.zh:
我们的顾问报告称，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的原住民不仅对我们的科技着迷，它们甚至也在模仿我们的行为举止。

有了这些我们给予他们的新式武器，[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]对战争之道有了新的认识。自我们到来之后，他们的社会迅速军事化。
texts.en:
The natives on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have not only become enamored with our technology, but our advisors report that they are also beginning to emulate our ways.

With the new weapons we are giving them access to, the [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural] have developed a new appreciation for the art of war. Their society has become significantly militarized since our arrival.

texts.zh:
我们的顾问报告称，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的原住民不仅对我们的科技着迷，它们甚至也在模仿我们的行为举止。

我们成为了极佳的榜样，教会了他们强大的、团结的领导价值。现在[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]意识到，这是让一个文明变得伟大的必由之路。
texts.en:
The natives on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have not only become enamored with our technology, but our advisors report that they are also beginning to emulate our ways.

We have served as a successful example, teaching them the value of strong, and united leadership. The [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural] now realize that this is the only way to achieve greatness as a civilization.

texts.zh:
我们的顾问报告称，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的原住民不仅对我们的科技着迷，它们甚至也在模仿我们的行为举止。

在看到我们的艺术和文化后倍受启发，[pre_ftl_species.GetName]社会似乎已经发展出了一种全新的平等主义认识。自我们到来以来，他们的个人自由程度大大增加了。
texts.en:
The natives on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have not only become enamored with our technology, but our advisors report that they are also beginning to emulate our ways.

Inspired by what they have seen of our art and culture, [pre_ftl_species.GetName] society appears to have developed a new sense of egalitarianism. Their personal freedoms have greatly increased since our arrival.

texts.zh:
我们的顾问报告称，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的原住民不仅对我们的科技着迷，它们甚至也在模仿我们的行为举止。

我们向[pre_ftl_species.GetName]传播科学观的任务对其社会造成了深远影响。有组织的宗教正在衰落，许多迷信被人们放弃。
texts.en:
The natives on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have not only become enamored with our technology, but our advisors report that they are also beginning to emulate our ways.

Our mission to teach the [pre_ftl_species.GetName] the value of science has profoundly affected their society. Organized religion is on the decline, and many superstitions are being abandoned.

texts.zh:
我们的顾问报告称，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的原住民不仅对我们的科技着迷，它们甚至也在模仿我们的行为举止。

见证了我们信念的力量之后，许多[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]前后簇拥着回归了他们文明的古老宗教，还把我们信仰中的某些元素与他们自己的信念融为一体。
texts.en:
The natives on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have not only become enamored with our technology, but our advisors report that they are also beginning to emulate our ways.

After witnessing the strength of our faith, many of the [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural] are flocking to the old religions of their civilization, incorporating elements of our beliefs into their own.

texts.zh:
我们派往[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]对[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]进行咨询事务的一部分科学家开始质疑我们这项任务的明智性。他们报告称，原住民似乎只对获得新武器技术产生了一些兴趣。

不幸的是，他们将我们带去的和平技术转化为战争器具的行为延缓了我们的任务进度。
texts.en:
Some of the scientists we sent to advise the [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural] of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have questioned the wisdom of our mission there. They report that the natives only seem interested in obtaining new weapons technology.

Their tiresome efforts to convert the peaceful technologies we offer them into instruments of war has unfortunately delayed the progress of our mission.

texts.zh:
我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上启蒙原住民文明的任务并未按计划进行。在我们传授它们新的武器技术时，[pre_ftl_species.GetName]科学家经常感到恐惧。

由于我们的科学顾问展示了在人口密集的城市上空引爆一颗聚变炸弹的仿真演示，他们花了好几周时间才将原住民的情绪安抚好。非常不幸，这大大拖延了我们的进度。
texts.en:
Our mission on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] to enlighten the native civilization is not proceeding as planned. The [pre_ftl_species.GetName] scientists frequently become horrified when we try to teach them about new weapons technology.

It took our scientific advisors weeks to calm them after we showed a simulation illustrating the effects of detonating a fusion bomb over a populated city. This has unfortunately delayed our progress.

texts.zh:
我们在对[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的人民开展提升文明的相关工作时遇到了一些困难。[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]实际上非常的迷信，有很多民众抱着古老的宗教传统不肯放手，拒绝接受唯物的证据，这让我们的科学顾问感到非常沮丧。

很不幸的是，我们对这一任务的预计似乎过于乐观了。
texts.en:
We are having difficulty working with the people on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] in our mission to elevate their civilization. The [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural] have proven to be a superstitious lot, and our scientific advisors are often frustrated by their arcane religious traditions and stubborn refusal to accept material proof.

Unfortunately, it looks like our initial time estimates for this mission were too optimistic.

texts.zh:
我们启蒙[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]并引导他们朝着正确道路迈向星辰的计划遇到了挫折。我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的宗教和科学顾问报告称，原住民没有信念依靠，这让人感到忧虑。他们很乐意接受我们的科技，但对于负责任地使用这些科技所必备的精神教导，他们不愿意接纳。

这极大地妨碍了我们引导[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]启蒙的任务。这下我们的计划又要延迟了。
texts.en:
Our efforts to enlighten the [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural] and lead them on the true path towards the stars have been frustrated. Our religious and scientific advisors on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] report a troubling lack of faith on behalf of the native population. They are willing to accept our technology readily enough, but not the spiritual lessons required to use it responsibly.

This has significantly hampered our mission to guide the [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural] to enlightenment. It will take longer than the signs ordained.

texts.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上压迫的、独裁的社会阻碍了我们推动[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]科技进步的任务。独立思想和开拓精神——这是科学蓬勃发展需要的品质——在[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]身上很罕见。

这种蛮横的威权主义拖累了我们任务的进度——–我们派往当地的科学顾问报告说，实际花费的时间超过预期。
texts.en:
The oppressive, autocratic society on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has frustrated our efforts to raise the technological level of the [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]. Individual thoughts and initiatives - on which science thrives - are discouraged among the [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural].

Their rampant authoritarianism has stymied the progress of our mission - the scientific advisors we sent report that it will likely take longer than expected.

texts.zh:
无政府主义政权在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的地上世界盛行，我们的顾问们向[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]传授现代科学的时候遇到了很大的困难。有时候，每位科学家对这个项目似乎都有不同的看法，全然不顾他们团队的需求或者公共利益。

我们的启蒙任务仍在继续，当地民众因为误导表现出了一定的平等主义，因此任务需要比预期更长的时间才能完成。
texts.en:
Anarchy reigns supreme on the surface of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName], and our advisors are having a difficult time teaching modern science to the [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]. At times it seems that every scientist has a different vision for the project, with no regard for the needs of their team or for the common good.

Our mission of enlightenment continues, despite the misguided egalitarianism displayed by the local population, but it will take longer than expected.
